title: On Bismut--Ambrose--Singer manifolds
summary: We investigate Bismut--Ambrose--Singer (BAS) manifolds, namely Hermitian manifolds whose Bismut connection has parallel torsion and parallel curvature. We first establish a canonical reduction theorem for complete, simply-connected BAS manifolds. We then classify simply-connected BAS manifolds in the three fundamental homogeneous settings: the compact case, the non-compact semisimple case, and the nilpotent case.
